title: Humanising LLM Outputs Is Dumb
summary: A critical opinion piece arguing against the trend of 'humanizing' LLM outputs, suggesting that artificially making AI text feel more human is counterproductive and diminishes the value of AI-generated content's inherent clarity and efficiency.
problem_solved: Challenges the misguided practice of artificially enhancing AI outputs to sound more human-like.
why_valuable: Offers a contrarian perspective that encourages rethinking our assumptions about what makes AI content valuable.
